name: STAC Asset Component Ontology
title: Definitions for the STAC Asset Object component
description: Vocabulary for the STAC Asset Object component: assets:roles, with recommended values drawn from the STAC specification's best-practice Asset Roles vocabulary (assets:AssetRoleScheme, a skos:ConceptScheme). The Asset Object's other fields (href, title, description, type) are reused from JSON-LD @id, dct:title, dct:description and dct:format; stac:Asset/stac:hasAsset are reused from the STAC core ontology, not redefined.

examples.title: A data asset with a custom role alongside a recommended one
